0.content: In the Tower of Inversion quest (Nightingale's Song), Alia notes that Illuga's tense manner reminds her of Solovei, and says that explains why the nightingale stayed by his side. She confirms to Paimon that Aedon is from five hundred years ago: he once followed Solovei from the homeland to this bitter frontier, was taken in by her when Solovei cast aside the Nightingale family name, and was pulled into the Sampo Mill when she threw herself into it to stop the Professor.

1.content: Illuga carries a lantern from which Aedon is called in battle. Illuga's Character Story titled "Aedon" says the bird is a reliable companion and that learning it once belonged to Solovei changed little for him. In his voice-overs Illuga says Aedon alerts him to danger and lights the way ahead, and he wonders whether Aedon might be more than a regular messenger bird.
